# Visual Mermaid

> Visual Mermaid (full name "Visual Mermaid Diagrams for Confluence") is an Atlassian Confluence Cloud app by Schneiderman Tech for Mermaid diagrams. Users draw and edit diagrams by clicking (rename, add, connect, delete boxes) or by writing Mermaid code, and both stay in sync.

Key facts:
- Platform: Confluence Cloud only (built on Atlassian Forge, "Runs on Atlassian").
- Edit visually or as Mermaid code; every click rewrites the Mermaid source.
- Paste Mermaid generated by any AI tool and fix it visually.
- "Render all Mermaid code blocks" page action converts every Mermaid code block on a page into a live diagram in one step.
- No login or extra account for authors or readers; no external network requests; diagram source is stored and versioned in the page.
- Price: free for Confluence sites with up to 10 users.
- Confluence Cloud does not render Mermaid natively.
